name_reason: Compliant and accurate. fd2_ prefix (game fn) + chapter_event_handler domain descriptor. The '00' suffix is the dispatch-table index (idx 0x00 of the per-event handler table at 0x51B91, confirmed: first table entry bytes db 41 03 00 = 0x341DB), a meaningful domain ID, NOT an address residue (fn is at 0x341DB). 'ch1' = chapter 1 (meaningful chapter ID). 'dialog_with_state' correctly distinguishes it from pure dialog-only sibling handlers: it both shows dialog and mutates state (data_fd2_battle_anim_phase = 0), matching the file-wide naming convention.
purpose: Chapter 1 turn-event slot 0 handler (dispatch idx 0x00): plays the ch1 prologue beat where 哈諾 (char 1) appears with cutscene 7 + dialog page 0xB, then the portrait set swaps and cutscene 8 + dialog page 3 play.
logic_summary: Straight-line, no-branch beat (cyclomatic 1). Spawn runtime char 1 from base+growth; load portrait set 3; pan camera to world (5,8); composite battle frame; delay 100ms; cutscene event 7; flush keyboard; show dialog page 0xB (text base data_fd2_current_chapter_text, geometry 0xA0000,0x140,0xCD,0x4C,0x4A,0x13,1); set data_fd2_battle_anim_phase = 0; swap to portrait set 7; composite battle frame; delay 100ms; cutscene event 8; flush keyboard; show dialog page 3 (same geometry); clear all chars' facing. No RNG, no numeric computation, no CALL-return value consumed. __CHK(0x2C) stack-probe prologue is compiler-injected; EBX callee-saved.

params.name: event_arg
params.semantics: Dispatch argument passed by the per-event handler table at 0x51B91 (uniform 1-arg cdecl). This handler never reads it (source casts (void)event_arg).
params.reason: Accurate name for the uniform dispatch arg; not an address residue. Body does not use it, so a more specific name is not warranted; 'event_arg' matches the convention used across all sibling handlers in this file.
